aboutSubheading: Your local tiling and renovation experts
aboutText: Melbourne Tiling Services has been providing high-end quality bathroom renovations and tiling solutions to Highett and surrounding suburbs for over a decade. Specialising in wall and floor tiling, waterproofing, and complete bathroom makeovers, we pride ourselves on attention to detail and customer satisfaction. Our team is fully licensed and committed to delivering affordable yet superior results for every project.
servicesText: From initial design to final touches, we offer a full range of services including tiling, waterproofing, and shower screen installation. Serving Highett and Melbourne, we ensure every job is completed to the highest standard with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Wall & Floor Tiling
services.desc: Professional installation of ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone tiles for walls and floors, ensuring a flawless finish every time.

services.title: Waterproofing
services.desc: Certified waterproofing services for bathrooms and wet areas, protecting your home from moisture damage and meeting Australian standards.

services.title: Bathroom Renovations
services.desc: Complete bathroom redesign and renovation, from demolition to final fixtures, tailored to your style and budget in Highett.

services.title: Shower Screen Installation
services.desc: Expert fitting of frameless and semi-frameless shower screens, enhancing the look and functionality of your bathroom.

services.title: Grouting & Caulking
services.desc: Precision grouting and caulking to seal tiles and prevent water ingress, maintaining the beauty and durability of your surfaces.

services.title: Bathroom Demolition & Design
services.desc: Safe removal of old fixtures and layout planning, working with you to create the perfect bathroom space.
